Conclusion: v8/v9: "k of 6 non-overlapping offsets positive" is robustness evidence
Why: The six offsets partition one series; their mean equals the full-series mean exactly (+0.1742 vs +0.1742). They measure start-date sensitivity, not replication. Every robustness claim resting on offsets is weaker than stated.

Conclusion: v9: "discovery >> validation decay is the signature of overfitting"
Why: On a common sample three of five signals improved out of sample. But v10 shows the common sample itself moves results (Macro disc IC 0.048 vs 0.079 across two samples), so neither version is a clean read.

Conclusion: v9: FCI improves out of sample because of a regime effect
Why: Validation has LOWER FCI cross-market dispersion (ratio 0.72), not higher, and corr(IC, dispersion) = -0.03. The improvement is not a dispersion artifact. Mild VIX-regime dependence remains (high-VIX IC +0.154 vs low-VIX +0.098).

Conclusion: v9: the Micro EPS pillar is "the strongest standalone signal"
Why: On the v10 sample Macro FCI has the stronger validation evidence (IC +0.175, t 2.49, full boot p 0.015) while Micro is +0.102, t 1.21. The ranking is sample-dependent, which is itself the finding.

Conclusion: v8: valuation V3 (multiple reversal) is the pillar winner
Why: Under discovery-only selection the best valuation candidate is P/E vs peers; it posts validation IC -0.064 and a significantly NEGATIVE incremental contribution (-0.091, HAC t -2.35, CI [-0.170,-0.025]).

Conclusion: v9: technical is rejected because the price series embeds earnings
Why: The price is genuine (v4 identity check). Momentum ratios do carry earnings information (R2 8.6-35.3% on the earnings block) but the new PATH family does not (R2 1.0-5.2%). Technical is rejected on its OUT-OF-SAMPLE RESULT, not on contamination.

Conclusion: Open question: why does cheapness predict multiple expansion but not total return
Why: The two legs of the same market-month correlate -0.767. Predicting one leg positively means predicting the other negatively; they offset. The multiple leg is 79% of return variance but cannot be harvested alone.
